description:
Activate Tawnos's second ability by paying {1}{W}{U}{B}, tapping it and sacrificing two artifact tokens, exiling Sparring Mummy from your graveyard and creating a token copy of it that is an artifact in addition to its other types.
When the Sparring Mummy token enters, it triggers, untapping Tawnos.
Activate Tawnos's first ability by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a copy of the Sparring Mummy token and causing you to mill two cards.
When the Sparring Mummy token enters, it triggers, untapping Tawnos.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a Sparring Mummy token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 3.
